# Gilbert Blythe

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome fellow with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and broad shoulders. He has clear, straightforward eyes and is known for his cheerful, frank demeanor. Following a severe bout of typhoid fever, he appeared pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and hard-working, demonstrating high academic determination alongside a lively sense of humor. He is naturally good-natured, popular, and playful, often engaging in teasing banter with his companions. Possessing a thoughtful and self-sacrificing nature, he constantly strives to better himself and support those he cares about.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v4 c29 P38](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0038)_

## History

After living in Alberta for three years with his father, Gilbert returned to Avonlea and resumed his schooling, quickly establishing a keen academic rivalry with Anne Shirley. He later attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne, completing the Second Year work in a single year to earn a First Class teacher's license. To finance his higher education, he spent time teaching at White Sands School before resigning his application for the Avonlea school to let Anne remain close to home. He served as the president of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society during this period and actively planned local enhancements. Moving on to Redmond College, Gilbert excelled as a student, leading the Freshmen in the Arts Rush, serving as class president, and playing as captain of the Freshman football team. He eventually graduated with High Honors in Classics, winning the prestigious Cooper Prize. Following a life-threatening bout of typhoid fever, he reconciled with Anne, leading to their eventual marriage in the orchard at Green Gables. Settling in Four Winds, Gilbert succeeded his great-uncle as the local country doctor and built a home with Anne, becoming a father to their son, Little Jem.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)_
